descriptions.value: The MAIO WordPress plugin before 7.3.22 does not properly restrict access to its analytics data, treating a credential value shipped verbatim in its own public source as a valid API key, which allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve the stored crawl-analytics log, including each recorded visitor's IP address, user agent and referer.

assertions.title: MAIO < 7.3.22 - Unauthenticated Crawl Analytics Disclosure via Hardcoded API Key

descriptions.description: CWE-200 Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

title: MAIO < 7.3.22 - Unauthenticated Crawl Analytics Disclosure via Hardcoded API Key
